reason: V1 keeps every fact, commitment and nuance. V5 only drops 'closely', and V2 drops 'a schedule you can plan a life around'. V4 softens and reinterprets several points ('slammed' becomes 'busy/fun part', 'nights that end at a decent hour', 'care whether' becomes 'taste'). V3 loses many commitments (no pressure-cooker kitchen, a real say, calm under pressure, nights that end) and adds new ones ('not limited to', 'must', 'work well with others', 'me' instead of 'us').
